Manage long-lead equipment procurement (transformers, generators, UPS, chillers) including FAT oversight. Prepare and present progress reports, KPIs, cost forecasts, and milestone updates to senior management and stakeholders. Engineering & Technical Oversight Review, approve, and coordinate technical designs: electrical, mechanical, HVAC, fire protection, security, and IT infrastructure. Validate system redundancy (N+1, N+2, 2N, 2N+1) and operational reliability requirements. Ensure compliance with local regulations, utility requirements, and international standards (Uptime Tier III/IV, NFPA, IEC, TIA, ISO). Coordinate with utility providers for grid interconnection, energization, and regulatory approvals. Oversee HV/MV infrastructure delivery, protection coordination, and energization strategy. Supervise Testing & Commissioning (Level 1–5) including IST, FMEA validation, black building tests, and reliability verification. Review power system studies (short circuit, load flow, arc flash) and reliability analysis. Oversee vendor, contractor, and consultant performance to meet technical specifications and project objectives. Commercial & Financial Control Monitor CAPEX budgets, cost forecasts, and financial controls. Track procurement schedules and mitigate supply chain risks. Review progress payment certifications and contractor claims. Ensure performance bond, insurance (CAR/EAR), and risk transfer compliance. Participate in tender evaluations and contract award recommendations. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead multi-disciplinary project teams, contractors, consultants, and internal engineers. Act as primary interface between clients, suppliers, utility authorities, and internal teams. Mentor junior engineers and project staff, fostering knowledge transfer and operational excellence. Ensure seamless communication and coordination across all stakeholders. Support Director of Engineering in strategic planning and executive reporting. Environmental & Permitting Compliance Lead and coordinate the end-to-end AMDAL process for JKTxx (items 9a–9k), including AmdalNet registration, Public Announcement, Public Consultation/Hearing (Konsultasi Publik), village/sub-district recommendations, Terms of Reference (Kerangka Acuan), wastewater technical approval (Pertek BMAL), emissions technical approval (Pertek Emisi), hazardous waste technical requirements (Rintek B3), ANDAL assessment/hearing, RKL-RPL, and Environmental Approval issuance. Develop, maintain and coordinate RKL-RPL / UKL-UPL and associated environmental documentation, ensuring alignment between approved environmental commitments, design development and actual construction activities. Lead coordination of PBG and associated building approval technical packages, and track SLF readiness throughout construction, testing, commissioning and handover. Coordinate other applicable business, environmental, utility and statutory permits/approvals, including identifying any new requirements arising from design or scope changes. Act as the primary technical interface with the permitting consultant and relevant government/regulatory authorities, including DLH, local government and other applicable agencies, coordinating with GTN Legal where legal interpretation or formal corporate representation is required. Maintain a live master permit tracker as the single technical source of truth for JKTxx, covering submission dates, authority comments, outstanding information, responsible PIC, target approval dates, validity/expiry dates, dependencies and risks to the project program. Maintain a complete permit evidence and correspondence register, including submissions, approvals, authority comments, meeting minutes, commitments and supporting technical documentation. Integrate permitting milestones and dependencies into the overall project program, identify critical-path permitting risks and escalate potential impact to construction, energization, commissioning and RFS dates to APAC Engineering leadership. Ensure construction activities remain within the scope and conditions of approved permits. Assess design, construction or operational changes for potential permit/AMDAL impact before implementation. Provide technical risk assessments for permitting and compliance gaps and develop mitigation/recovery plans with consultants, contractors and relevant stakeholders. Coordinate environmental compliance obligations during construction, including wastewater, emissions, noise, hazardous waste (B3), construction waste, environmental monitoring and reporting, as applicable. Support environmental, health and safety (EHS) initiatives and ensure statutory and environmental commitments are maintained throughout the design, construction, commissioning and operational handover lifecycle. Lead and coordinate community and local stakeholder engagement associated with permitting and construction, including village/sub-district leadership, surrounding residents, estate management and other affected stakeholders. Act as the GTN/ECX local point of contact for community matters, ensuring concerns, complaints and commitments are formally recorded, assigned, tracked and closed. Coordinate with consultants and contractors to ensure consistent communication with communities and authorities and prevent unauthorized commitments being made on behalf of GTN/ECX. Maintain a community/stakeholder engagement and commitment register, including issues raised, agreed actions, responsible PICs and closure dates. Enforce adherence to ECX engineering standards, corporate governance and safety requirements, and support QA/QC inspections where required to verify that installed works remain consistent with approved designs and permit conditions. Lead and coordinate community engagement activities, including consultation with local communities and obtaining required recommendations/support from village and sub-district authorities. Act as the primary local point of contact for community engagement, proactively addressing and coordinating the resolution of community concerns, issues, and feedback related to project activities. Operation and Handover Facilitate smooth transition to operations including as-built documentation, SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, and asset registers. Ensure operational readiness, maintainability, and uptime SLA compliance. Support training of O&M teams and post-handover stabilization. Validate performance metrics including PUE, WUE, and system reliability KPIs. Education & Certifications Bachelor's degree in electrical, Mechanical, or Building Services Engineering. Preferred: CDCP, PMP, ATD (Accredited Tier Designer). Professional certification in environmental management/AMDAL (e.g., AMDAL Penyusun certification) an advantage. Experience Minimum 10 years in data center construction, commissioning, or hyperscale infrastructure projects. Experience with 150kV grid intake and campus-scale developments preferred. Proven delivery of large-scale Tier III+ or hyperscale DCs (50 MW+) in SEA Hands-on experience with critical systems: chillers, CRAH/CRAC, UPS, generators, LV/MV electrical distribution, BMS/SCADA, fire protection systems. Experience managing EPC / D&B contractors and complex stakeholder environments. Experience managing AMDAL and Indonesian development permitting processes (AMDAL, PBG, PB, SLF), ideally for industrial, data center, or large infrastructure projects in West Java/Bekasi. review_candidates.description: FHI 360 est une organisation à but non lucratif dédiée au développement humain dédiée à l'amélioration durable des conditions de vie en fournissant des solutions intégrées et locales. Notre équipe comprend des experts en santé, éducation, nutrition, environnement, développement économique, jeunesse, recherche, technologie, communication, et marketing social – créant un mélange unique de capacités pour relever les défis interconnectés du développement actuels. FHI 360 dessert plus de 70 pays ainsi que tous les États et territoires des États-Unis. Nous recherchons actuellement des candidats qualifiés pour le poste de responsable financier pour le projet STRIDES Cameroun. Le poste sera basé à Yaounde, au Cameroun. Description du projet STRIDES : Le programme STRIDES (Renforcement des systèmes de détection des maladies infectieuses) est un projet finance par le Département d’Etat Américain, et constitue un atout essentiel pour la réponse du gouvernement des États-Unis en matière de sécurité sanitaire mondiale. L'équipe multidisciplinaire d'experts de STRIDES se mobilise rapidement pour aider les gouvernements des pays partenaires à endiguer les épidémies avant qu'elles ne se propagent. STRIDES renforce également la surveillance des maladies, les réseaux de laboratoires et les systèmes de notification afin que les pays puissent prévenir, détecter et combattre efficacement les maladies infectieuses émergentes susceptibles de provoquer des épidémies. Description de l'emploi : Sous la supervision du Directeur Finance et Administration de FHI 360 Cameroun et en étroite collaboration avec le Directeur de Projet STRIDES Cameroun, le Manager Finance fournira le leadership, la direction managériale et l'appui pratique au projet pour la gestion financière, administrative et des contrats. Il/elle assurera la supervision et la haute performance de l'équipe financière, des contrats et de l'administration du projet STRIDES. Il/elle soutiendra le développement des capacités au sein de l'équipe tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de la plateforme FHI 360 Cameroun en charge de la gestion financière, l'équipe du projet STRIDES au Cameroun, et l'équipe du siège STRIDES. Responsabilités du poste Veiller à ce que tous les systèmes et processus administratifs (y compris la gestion des achats, l'administration des voyages, l'inventaire et la gestion des biens) soient très fiables, bien adaptés, et conformes aux politiques et procédures des donateurs et de l'organisation. Diriger l'élaboration de budgets de haute qualité pour les plans de travail et les rapports financiers, ainsi que tout autre rapport requis par l'équipe de gestion du projet et du Département D’Etat Américain. Veiller à ce que toutes les dépenses du projet soient conformes aux politiques et procédures de FHI 360 ainsi qu’aux règles et réglementations des bailleurs relatives aux finances, à l’administration, aux opérations et au personnel, et qu’elles soient appuyées par une documentation complète et exacte. Examiner et suivre le(s) budget(s) du programme, surveiller les dépenses et appuyer la préparation des rapports financiers destinés au siège et aux bailleurs, selon les besoins. Comprendre les exigences de contrôle interne et s’assurer que les mouvements de trésorerie et dépenses respectent les protocoles appropriés. Préparer les projections de dépenses en collaboration avec les responsables de projet, appuyer les équipes techniques de projet dans la planification et la budgétisation des activités, et fournir un appui administratif et logistique de voyage au personnel technique. Aider à l'organisation et à la préparation de divers audits de comptes et d'états financiers. Veiller au respect total des politique contractuelle de FHI 360 et des réglementations du Département D’Etat Américain applicables aux contrats, et contrôler le respect des termes et conditions du contrat. Participer aux travaux comptables : vérification des pièces justificatives, suivi des paiements et traitement des opérations dans le logiciel comptable. Préparer les demandes de remboursement des fonds du siège, préparer et/ou réviser en collaboration avec le Procurement Manager les dossiers d'approvisionnement pour le projet STRIDES. Assurer une gestion efficace des contrats ; développer et mettre en œuvre des systèmes de gestion et de contrôle solides pour que FHI 360 respecte les conditions de l'accord et ses politiques. Participer à la gestion des avances, contrôler et régler les avances pour les missions, les ateliers, le personnel, les partenaires et les consultants. Expérience en pratiques comptables gouvernementales, systèmes fédéraux de réglementation des marchés publics (FAR) et CFR 200, expérience des principes comptables généralement acceptés (GAAP), et ASC 842 Lease Accounting. Participer à la préparation des salaires et à l'établissement des déclarations d'impôts et de taxes Assurer la bonne gestion opérationnelle du projet, y compris les besoins en matière de logistique et de coordination administrative, les achats, le transport, etc. Collaborer avec l'équipe de la plateforme nationale de FHI360 et le personnel régional pour assurer le soutien nécessaire aux fonctions financières et administratives, et superviser et soutenir le personnel financier et administratif du projet. Connaissances et Compétences Requises Excellente maîtrise de la comptabilité, des contrôles internes et des systèmes d'information financière. Bonne connaissance du référentiel comptable OHADA (SYSCOHADA) et de la réglementation fiscale et sociale camerounaise. Expérience avérée en gestion financière, budgétaire et en reporting financier. Solide compréhension des normes comptables, des procédures d'audit et des exigences de conformité. Excellentes capacités de leadership, de supervision et de gestion d'équipes multidisciplinaires. Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, en négociation et en relations interpersonnelles. Capacité à fournir des orientations stratégiques et à collaborer efficacement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Excellentes aptitudes organisationnelles, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter les délais. Maîtrise des outils informatiques et des logiciels de gestion financière. Résolution de problèmes et impact Traite des problématiques de complexité modérée à élevée nécessitant une analyse approfondie des données, des risques et de multiples facteurs. Exerce un jugement professionnel dans l'application des politiques, procédures et pratiques de l'organisation afin de déterminer les approches et solutions les plus appropriées. Les décisions prises ont un impact direct sur la gestion financière, les opérations et la performance globale de l'organisation. Encadrement et supervision Poste de niveau managérial. Travaille sous la supervision générale du Directeur Finance et Administration, avec un degré élevé d'autonomie dans l'exercice de ses fonctions. Assure l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement des membres de l'équipe afin de garantir des résultats de qualité dans le respect des délais. Capacité à mobiliser et à gérer efficacement des équipes aux profils, expériences et compétences diversifiés. Ce poste est directement rattaché au Directeur Finance et Administration (Finance and Administration Director). FORMATION/EXPÉRIENCE Minimum BAC+3 en finance et comptabilité ou un diplôme équivalent Au moins 5 à 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle, dont 5 ans dans le domaine de la comptabilité et de la finance. Une expérience préalable dans la gestion d'un service d'analyse financière est requise. Connaissance avérée du processus de gestion des subventions et des règlements des bailleurs de fonds régissant l'administration des subventions. Expérience de travail avec des ONG internationales requise ; expérience de travail avec des projets financés par le Département D’Etat Américain souhaitée Capacité avérée à travailler en équipe et de manière indépendante. Avoir fait preuve de leadership, de polyvalence et d'intégrité Maîtrise d'Excel, de Word et d'au moins un logiciel de comptabilité Excellente capacité à communiquer en anglais et français tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Exigences physiques du poste : Travail dans un environnement de bureau classique. Capacité à passer de longues heures devant un écran d’ordinateur et à effectuer des tâches répétitives au clavier. Capacité à rester assis(e) ou debout pendant des périodes prolongées. Capacité à soulever ou déplacer des charges allant jusqu’à environ 2,3 kg Technologies et équipements utilisés : Ordinateur de bureau/ordinateur portable ; Applications Microsoft (notamment Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams) ; Téléphone portable et technologies mobiles ; Équipements de bureau. review_candidates.title: Operational Technology Technician
review_candidates.description: About The Role At National Grid Interconnectors, we're playing a vital role in delivering the UK's net zero future. Our high-voltage direct current (HVDC) interconnectors connect Great Britain's energy system with those of our nearest neighbours, enabling the secure transfer of electricity across borders and supporting a cleaner, more resilient energy network. As our portfolio continues to grow, we're looking for an Operational Technology (OT) Technician to join our Operations team. In this role, you'll help ensure the reliable and secure operation of critical OT systems, networking infrastructure, and cyber assets that support our interconnector sites and control room environments. Working as part of a highly skilled team, you'll play a key part in maintaining system performance, strengthening cyber security, and supporting the safe operation of nationally important energy infrastructure. The role is based onsite at Vikinglink based in Bickerfen, so please ensure you have a full UK driving licence and are within travelling distance of site. What you'll do As an OT Technician, you'll support the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and security of Operational Technology assets across our interconnector sites, responsibilities include; Installing, maintaining, refurbishing and repairing OT systems, networking infrastructure and cyber security assets. Performing routine operational activities, including software patching, antivirus updates, backups and access permission reviews. Monitoring asset condition and system performance to identify and resolve issues proactively. Supporting both planned and reactive maintenance activities across site systems. Ensuring all work is completed safely and in compliance with applicable legislation, business procedures and regulatory requirements. Participating in a site call-out rota and supporting live operational incidents when required. Managing and supporting third-party contractors carrying out planned and unplanned works. Supporting cyber security, engineering and assurance initiatives across interconnector sites and control rooms. Assisting with asset management, change management and spare equipment readiness. Supporting backup, restoration and recovery activities for critical operational systems. Installing and testing hardware and network changes. Acting as a superuser for privileged devices, supporting software builds, device management and operational use cases. Assisting with the management of supporting infrastructure, including power supplies, cooling systems and physical security controls. Supporting audits, inspections and compliance reporting activities. Occasional travel may be required across our Interconnectors portfolio, including IFA, IFA2, NSL and Viking Link sites. What you'll need We're Looking For Someone With a Strong Technical Mindset And a Passion For Working On Critical Infrastructure. You Don't Need To Have Direct Interconnector Experience, But You'll Need Experience or knowledge of Operational Technology systems, networks, cyber security assets, building management systems, control systems or similar technologies. The ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative operational team. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to resolving issues. Good IT and computer literacy skills. An understanding of health, safety and environmental requirements within an operational or engineering environment. Strong communication skills and a positive, can-do attitude. Experience using asset management systems such as Maximo, Ellipse, IFS or similar would be advantageous. Competent Person authorisation, or the willingness and capability to work towards achieving it. NVQ Level 3 qualification in Engineering, IT, Telecommunications or a related discipline, or an equivalent recognised apprenticeship. Desirable; NVQ Level 4 qualification in Engineering, IT, Telecommunications or a related discipline. IOSH, NEBOSH or equivalent health and safety qualification. Experience within utilities, energy, critical infrastructure or a related industry. What you'll get A competitive salary between £43,315.00 - £47,137.00 – dependent on capability. As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few. More Information This role closes on 24th Sepetember 2026 at 23:59 , however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process. Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

Principais atividades: Apoiar os processos de fechamento financeiro mensal, trimestral e anual, assegurando precisão e conformidade com as normas IFRS. Conhecimento no sistema ERP MXM, desejável; Conhecimento em Power BI, desejável; Inglês intermediário será considerado um diferencial.
